key_objects.name_zh: 第 8 章的两大支柱
key_objects.description: The chapter emphasizes averaging operators and restriction theorems for the Fourier transform, then applies them to dispersive PDE, the Radon transform, and lattice-point counting.

key_objects.name_zh: 一个说明性例子
key_objects.description: Averaging over the unit sphere illustrates how curvature creates Fourier decay and L2 smoothing.

key_objects.name_en: first-order L2 smoothing estimate for spherical averages

key_objects.name_en: Fourier transform of surface measure on S2

key_objects.name_en: decay estimate for surface measure on S2

key_objects.name_zh: R^d 中的球面平均算子
球面平均的 Sobolev 平滑
key_objects.statement: The map f↦A(f) is bounded from L^2(R^d) to L^2_k(R^d), where k=(d-1)/2.

key_objects.name_zh: 球面测度 Fourier 变换的 Bessel 表示
key_objects.name_en: Bessel representation of the Fourier transform of sphere measure

key_objects.name_zh: 径向函数 Fourier 变换公式
key_objects.name_en: Fourier transform formula for radial functions

key_objects.name_zh: 球面测度的一般维数衰减
曲率、Fourier 衰减与平滑的联系
key_objects.description: The text asks whether the sphere estimate persists for general hypersurfaces and explains that nonvanishing curvature controls Fourier decay, whereas flat hypersurfaces can fail to decay. The L2 smoothing degree k=(d-1)/2 is special to L2.

key_objects.name_zh: 三维波动方程的球面平均解
key_objects.name_en: spherical-mean solution of the 3D wave equation
key_objects.description: For d=3, with Δ_x u=∂_t^2u, u(x,0)=0 and ∂_t u(x,0)=f(x), the solution at t=1 is u(x,1)=A(f)(x); other times follow by rescaling.

key_objects.name_zh: 振荡积分
key_objects.description: Basic stationary-phase estimates for integrals with large real parameter λ.

key_objects.name_zh: 振荡积分 I(λ)
振荡积分基本形式
key_objects.name_en: basic form of an oscillatory integral

key_objects.name_zh: 驻相原理
key_objects.description: Where ∇Φ is nonzero, repeated integration by parts gives rapid decay in λ; the main contribution comes from critical points where ∇Φ=0.

key_objects.name_zh: 非驻相区域的快速衰减
key_objects.name_en: rapid decay away from stationary points
key_objects.statement: If |∇Φ(x)|≥c>0 on supp ψ, then for every N≥0, |I(λ)|≤c_N λ^{-N} for λ>0.

key_objects.name_zh: 非驻相积分分部积分算子
key_objects.description: Repeatedly transpose L onto ψ to gain one factor λ^{-1} at each step.

key_objects.name_zh: 一维无振幅振荡积分 I1
van der Corput 一阶导数检验
key_objects.statement: If Φ∈C^2([a,b]), Φ' is monotone, and |Φ'|≥1 on [a,b], then |I_1(λ)|≤3λ^{-1} for all λ>0.

key_objects.name_zh: 一阶导数检验的缩放形式
二次相位的驻相渐近展开
van der Corput 二阶导数检验
key_objects.statement: If Φ∈C^2([a,b]) and |Φ''(x)|≥1 throughout [a,b], then |I_1(λ)|≤8λ^{-1/2} for all λ>0.

key_objects.name_zh: 二阶导数检验的 λ^{-1/2} 衰减
key_objects.name_en: lambda^{-1/2} decay in the second-derivative test

key_objects.name_zh: 带振幅的一维二阶导数估计
key_objects.statement: If Φ satisfies Proposition 2.3 and ψ∈C^1([a,b]), then |∫_a^b e^{iλΦ(x)}ψ(x)dx|≤c_ψ λ^{-1/2}, with c_ψ=8(∫_a^b|ψ'|dx+|ψ(b)|).

key_objects.name_zh: 带振幅 van der Corput 估计
key_objects.name_en: van der Corput estimate with amplitude

key_objects.name_zh: 固定整数阶 Bessel 函数的衰减
相位函数的 Hessian
非退化 Hessian 条件
多维非退化驻相衰减
key_objects.statement: If det(∇^2Φ)≠0 on supp ψ, then I(λ)=O(λ^{-d/2}) as λ→∞.

key_objects.name_zh: 多维振荡积分 λ^{-d/2} 衰减
key_objects.name_en: lambda^{-d/2} decay for multidimensional oscillatory integrals

key_objects.name_en: rapid decay of the phase-difference integral J_lambda(u)

key_objects.name_zh: 相位梯度差与 |u| 可比
key_objects.name_en: comparability of the phase-gradient difference with |u|

key_objects.name_zh: 积分分部向量场系数的导数估计
key_objects.name_en: derivative bound for the integration-by-parts vector field coefficient

key_objects.name_zh: Proposition 2.5 的定量化说明起点
key_objects.name_en: start of quantitative refinements to Proposition 2.5
key_objects.description: Item (i) notes that C^{d+2} regularity of Φ and C^{d+1} regularity of ψ suffice, and that the constant depends only on corresponding norms, a lower bound for |det ∇²Φ|, and the diameter of supp ψ. Further elaborations continue on PDF 351.
